declarations.name: AuiInlineMessage

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: Tone: icon, colors, and hidden tone prefix.

inputs.name: live
inputs.description: off: static; polite: role=status; assertive: role=alert.

accessibility.pattern: Status message (WCAG 4.1.3): role=status for polite updates, role=alert for urgent ones, plain text when static.

limitations: Live roles only announce changes made after the live region exists; set live when creating the message and change it with update().
Text only: no links or rich content.
